newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Incomplete Argentine unemployment seen at 17.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Incomplete Argentine unemployment seen at 17.2 pct.

text.p: Argentina's unemployment rate to be announced later Friday will be 17.2 percent but will not include the province of Cordoba, an Economy Ministry official said Friday.
"Unemployment will be 17.2 percent, not including Cordoba, and we estimate it would be 17.5 percent including Cordoba," the official, who asked not to be named, told reporters.
He said statistical work in Cordoba was delayed and the province's unemployment rate will be announced separately later.
The Economy Ministry said earlier Friday that it had decided to announce the October unemployment figures early, instead of December 18 as previously planned. It did not give a reason.
Unemployment was 17.1 percent the last time it was measured, in May, and 18.4 percent in October 1995.
